name: Raspberry Pi 5 (4GB)
test: Shared Python CV, mission, route and safety logic on this laptop; laptop timing is measured.

name: ESP32 DevKit V1
test: Actual ESP32 firmware compiled for the host with a virtual Arduino HAL, serial protocol and watchdog.

name: US-100 ultrasonic sensor
test: Ray-cone echo distances, timed sampling, local emergency interlock and release behavior.

name: Waveshare SIM7600G-H 4G HAT
test: CGPSINFO parser, virtual GNSS fixes, app-command transport delay, dropped connection and expired commands.

name: SEMENERG 12V 6Ah LiFePO4 battery
test: Correct supply assumed; supply-interruption test. No discharge, battery-management or current model.

name: Yellow TT DC gear motors
test: Four torque-limited physics motors with editable duty/speed and unequal wheel gains.

name: L298N motor drivers
test: Firmware PWM/direction/braking outputs drive left/right motor sides. Voltage loss/heat are not modeled.

name: Arducam IMX708 Camera V3
test: Rendered RGB pixels, editable FOV/mount/resolution, actual YOLOE CV and camera-cover failure.

name: MPU-6050 (GY-521)
test: Webots gyro through virtual I2C MPU registers into firmware heading integration.

name: Photo interrupter modules
test: Wheel rotation creates four single-channel pulse streams; simulation assumes 20 slots per revolution.

name: 5.1V/5A voltage regulator
test: Correct Pi supply assumed. No transient, current-limit or conversion-efficiency model.

name: 6V/10A voltage regulator
test: Correct motor supply assumed by the editable 6V motor plant.

name: 5V/1A voltage regulator
test: Correct accessory supply assumed. No electrical simulation.

name: Thermaltake SWAFAN EX12 fans
test: Cooling is assumed available; fan power/airflow and Pi thermal throttling need a physical test.

name: Yellow motor wheels
test: 65mm diameter, 27mm width, slip/friction, wheelbase and track assumptions are editable.

name: GPS antenna
test: Fix acquisition, loss, update age and uncertainty fixtures. No satellite/RF model.

name: LTE antenna
test: Connection availability and app message latency fixture. No RF coverage or carrier registration model.

name: Main power switch
test: Supply-interruption fixture; restoration requires a new mission command/verification.

name: Fuse holder
test: Correct installation assumed; fuse sizing and fault-current protection are not simulated.
